acip: DE DAG GI LAS KYI SGRIB PA THAMS CAD YONGS SU BYANG BAR 'GYUR, MYA NGAN DANG, SDUG BSNGAL DANG, YID MI BDE BA DANG, 'KHRUG PA THAMS CAD LAS YONGS SU THAR BAR 'GYUR,
wylie: de dag gi las kyi sgrib pa thams cad yongs su byang bar 'gyur, mya ngan dang, sdug bsngal dang, yid mi bde ba dang, 'khrug pa thams cad las yongs su thar bar 'gyur
english: The karmic obstacles of these people then will be cleaned away from them, completely.  They will be forever freed from all forms of sadness; and physical pain; from unhappiness and confusion.
